title: [PLACEHOLDER] The VAPT Engagement Lifecycle

nodes.label: [PLACEHOLDER] Scoping
nodes.detail: [PLACEHOLDER] Define targets, rules of engagement, and timeline

nodes.label: [PLACEHOLDER] Reconnaissance
nodes.detail: [PLACEHOLDER] Gather intelligence on the target environment

nodes.label: [PLACEHOLDER] Scanning

nodes.label: [PLACEHOLDER] Reporting
